submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Edit target Image 1 is our cast/E/01 ready pose. Correct ONLY full-character registration and scale on its square transparent canvas; keep the same calm right-facing ready pose, all anatomy, face, costume, five individual red talisman cards held in anatomical RIGHT hand, and one bronze bell with red tassel held in anatomical LEFT hand. Do not change the drawing, styling, or relative head/body proportions.
The target currently occupies too much of the square and sits too low. Repaint it at a uniform reduced character scale so that its ENTIRE crown/ponytail top-to-shoe-bottom height is approximately 76% of the canvas height. Highest hair point should be at 14% down from canvas top. Both planted shoe soles should rest at the invisible ground at 90% down from canvas top, with a CLEAR EMPTY TRANSPARENT MARGIN of 10% of canvas below both feet. Horizontal virtual root remains at canvas center 50%; hip center should be above that root. This 14%-to-90% vertical footprint is the primary edit. All body parts, props, ribbons and costume scale together; do not just shrink the head or shorten legs. Do not fill the canvas.
Image 2 is the release key of this same sequence: match its approximate camera, clean detail, face identity, character scale and virtual ground, while preserving Image 1's quiet ready pose and narrower foot stance. Image 3 is authoritative identity/prop ownership only. Image 4 establishes the right-facing E camera; its overlapping hands are ambiguous, so keep prop ownership from Image 1 and Image 3. Image 5 is the main approved hand-painted Taoist chibi style/material/finish reference; ignore UI and scenery.
One single full-body frame, square 1024 x 1024 RGBA intended output, native single frame at least 1024. True alpha transparency all around. No painted checkerboard, background, ground line, ground plane, shadow, labels, glow, detached particles, projectiles, effects or extra props. Keep both hands visibly gripping their props and both short legs/shoes separated. No mirroring.
